title: 2. Scene-by-Scene Novel Planner
use_cases: Use when breaking down a novel outline into actionable individual scenes
Implement when tracking character appearances and narrative emotional arcs
Configure when balancing high-action sequences with dialogue and reflection
Use when highlighting specific text passages for targeted AI-driven improvements
Implement when planning multi-POV narratives to ensure plot thread consistency
content:
Structure every chapter with precision.

Great novels are built scene by scene. PlotForge breaks your outline into individual scenes, each with clear objectives, emotional beats, and narrative purpose. You always know what comes next and why it matters.

#### Scene Planning Features

- Purpose-driven scenes with clear goals and conflicts
- Emotional beat tracking to manage reader engagement
- Character presence mapping showing who appears in each scene
- Pacing indicators to balance action, dialogue, and reflection
- Scene notes and reminders for research, callbacks, or foreshadowing

#### Writer Benefits

- Never write aimless scenes that don't advance the plot
- Balance emotional highs and lows throughout your narrative
- Track multiple storylines without losing threads
- Maintain momentum with clear scene objectives
- Perfect for genre fiction writers, screenplay adapters, and multi-POV narratives

Pro Tip

Pro Tip: Use scene planning to identify pacing issues before drafting. Authors who plan scenes in advance report 40% faster first draft completion.

Surgical precision for narrative refinement—now with selective text editing.

Scene Surgery lets you improve entire chapters or just specific passages. Highlight a single sentence, paragraph, or dialogue exchange to get targeted AI suggestions that enhance only what you selected—or analyze the full chapter for comprehensive improvements.
